description:
JMP offers a 30-day free trial for anyone, anywhere. Go to https://www.jmp.com/scishow  to see the benefits of visual statistics for yourself. 

Did you know the US Air Force put a space station in orbit all the way back in 1966? Or that in 1985, the USSR sent a whopping TWO cosmonauts into space to bring a whole space station (Salyut-7) back to life? These stories and more in this SciShow List Show about space stations that aren't the ISS.

Hosted by: Deboki Chakravarti (she/her)
